claims_and_caveats_checked: Thirteen retained state components and eleven independent dynamic coordinates; neither carbon, alkalinity, volume, finite lumen chemistry nor algebraic voltages frozen.
Twenty-six class/expression cases, twenty-two physiological entries; duplicate AE4-null systems identified.
WT/null slow chemical modes retained at approximately 346/460 s; inward regulatory derivative gives 30 s.
Thermodynamic opposition retained for C0/C3b/C4b cases; physiological gate acceptance is distinct.
NBC obstruction explicitly conditional on demand/capacity; a full-gate-valid no-NBC root exists at reduced AE4 loading.
Local NKCC gain includes the factor two; relative integrated increase and integrated replacement use distinct denominators and the declared 60–600 s window.
Adaptive and original sampled inverse crossings remain separate at approximately 89.507% and 89.508% recruitment.
The 30.3% comparison value is the experimental mean minus one reported standard error, not a confidence limit.
Task 41 remains target-selected; no independent validation, universal lower bound, proved global monotonicity or earlier-crossing exclusion is claimed.
Later pH failure is retained without changing the frozen 600 s observable.
Unknown parameter intervals limit the conclusions to local sensitivity; no invented robustness range.
The isolated 2015 NKCC assay tension and absence of a specific identified NBC isoform remain explicit.
